A black diamond ring that kept every mark. It still shines.

Disturbed is No. 4 in REMNANT. One marquise black diamond, set low in 14K gold. We polished half the band to a mirror and left the other half hammered, scarred, exactly as the tools made it.

Why leave it? Because most of us carry a year like that. A diagnosis, a breakup, a winter in 2019 that didn't end. You don't have to sand it away to be whole. You wear it.

Yellow, rose or white gold, made by hand in your size. It ships within 10 business days. Questions about sizing? Write to us, a real person answers.

5 black diamond rings named for the night sky, worn in plain daylight.

Algol, the star that goes dark and always comes back. Selkie, half sea and half shore. Cor Caroli, a heart someone put in the sky. Janus, looking back and forward at once. Phoenix, fire, then ash, then fire again.

We don't shoot them on velvet. We shoot them on a Tuesday, with a coffee, a sleeve pushed up, a hand in the hair. That's where they live.

Natural black diamonds from 0.6 to 3 carats, set in 14K yellow, rose or white gold, each ring made to order.

All ten new rings: link in bio.

4 black diamond rings named for Janus, Selkie, Melusine and the centaur. Every one has two faces.

Janus looks back and forward at the same time. January's named for him. A selkie sheds her seal skin on the shore by moonlight, then walks into town as a woman. Melusine? Woman above the water. Serpent below. She hid it from everyone she loved. The centaur carries wisdom and wildness in one body.

Sound familiar? We named these rings for them because that's how most of us live, soft and strong at once, tender and fierce in the same week. You don't have to pick a side.

Natural black diamonds in 14K gold. Made to order.

You survived it. Now you can wear it.

Everyone carries a year like that. A loss, a diagnosis, a goodbye, a night that didn't seem to end. It leaves a mark, and most of us spend a long time hiding it.

REMNANT is built on the opposite idea. In kintsugi, a broken bowl isn't thrown away or patched to look new. The break is mended in gold and left in plain sight, because that's where the story lives.

Every REMNANT piece starts from a break: a crack, a rough edge, a collapse. And every one ends whole. Not perfect. Whole.

Not a reminder of what hurt. Proof that you came through.

REMNANT launches October 25. Solid gold, dark natural diamonds, made to order by hand.

What did you come through this year? One word in the comments is enough. We read every one.
